text:
olivia (sales): Quick heads-up — spinning up a POC with a large EU retail bank. They've asked for SIG/CAIQ answers, a dataflow diagram showing EU residency, and a full subprocessor list + any KMS/HSM notes. Need deliverables by Friday EOD. Who can own?
ben (security): I can take SIG/CAIQ follow-up and subprocessor attestation. Need to confirm whether customer requires processor-only in EU or allowed trusted subprocessors outside EU with SCCs. Any note on sample data?
olivia (sales): They said test data will be synthetic but will include hashed customer IDs. Residency is key — they explicitly asked that customer PII stay in EU regions for the POC and want diagram showing where logs and metrics land.
kevin (solutions): For POC we can offer hosted in eu-west-1 or dedicated in their VPC. Quick checklist: 1) hosting region 2) KMS key scope (customer-managed?) 3) audit logs retention 4) subprocessor list + contracts.
ben (security): Right. Also check whether they need KMS in their tenant (bring-your-own-key) vs Redwood-managed. If BYOK/HSM required, Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS integration is the path. For hosted we can do customer KMS via external keywrap but must confirm with infra.
kevin (solutions): Timeline-wise: I can draft a simple dataflow and subproc list today. If they want an architecture sketch we should include: model inference nodes (EU), request routing, KV cache (ephemeral), persistent logs (EU only), metrics (scrubbed), and optional audit export. Here's a tiny ascii sketch I can include in response:```
Client (EU) -> ALB -> Inference pool (EU GPUs) -> KV cache (in-memory)
                                
Inference -> Metrics exporter (scrubbed) -> Monitoring (EU)
Inference -> Logs (PII-filter) -> Storage (EU)
Key ops: Customer KMS (optional) <-> Model nodes (keywrap)
```
natalie (product): For the SIG pieces, I'll attach the latest CAIQ-derived responses we maintain. Note: we've recently updated the encryption controls to call out KMS integration support and HSM note for Private. Need to mark which controls are 'depends on deployment mode'.
ben (security): Good call. I'll annotate the SIG answers with those caveats. Also will prepare the subprocessor CSV — include cloud provider, logging provider, telemetry vendor, SAML/SSO provider. Confirmed subprocessors should be the same as prod list; we can mark any POC-specific providers.
audit-bot: audit-bot uploaded file: /internal/artifacts/sig-caiq-2026-03-20.pdf
kevin (solutions): Olivia — for the customer ask about EU residency evidence, we should give them: 1) dataflow diagram (ascii + vis), 2) list of subprocessors with region columns, 3) screenshots of console region selection and storage bucket location, 4) KMS options doc. I can prepare 1-3 by EOD today, 4 by tomorrow.
olivia (sales): That works. Also flagging a pricing question from procurement — if they pick dedicated capacity for the POC (2x A10 GPUs, 4 week commit) what rough ARR/commit should I quote so procurement has an idea?
kevin (solutions): For short POCs we recommend monthly reserved for dedicated; rough ballpark i can give privately — want me to DM the procurement contact and cc you?
olivia (sales): Please DM, yes. Keep public thread focused on security artifacts.
ben (security): One more ask — can we confirm data deletion flow post-POC? They requested confirmation that test data will be deleted within X days and that backups are rotated. I'll add standard retention language and a deletion checklist they can sign.
kevin (solutions): I'll add a step in the diagram: "post-POC data purge (DB snapshot purge + object lifecycle)" and include sample commands we run.
ben (security): Sample wording for SIG comment: "Logs and metrics are routed to EU-only storage by default for EU-hosted deployments; hosted customers may choose customer-managed keys or dedicated deployments for HSM-level controls. Subprocessors and region mappings provided in attached CSV."
olivia (sales): Perfect. If we can get the attachments into a single artifact (zip) I will upload to the customer's secure portal and send an ask for a short NDA addendum covering subprocessor disclosure.
audit-bot: audit-bot uploaded file: /internal/artifacts/eu-subprocessors-2026-03-20.csv
kevin (solutions): Attached draft dataflow PNG and simple checklist — pushing to the shared folder now.
ben (security): I'll finish SIG annotations and subproc attest by tomorrow morning.
olivia (sales): Thanks team — I'll plan to send initial packet to customer Friday AM and follow up on pricing separately. :thumbsup:
